lines.text: Objective: {task}. Proceed quietly.
Operation {task} is live. Move in silence.
{task}. Mission accepted. The shadows are in position.
{task}: cold case, thirty days or more. Reopened. The element of surprise is yours.
{task} has been under observation for days. Today we move.
{task}: complete. No witnesses. Stand down, or select the next objective.
Mission report: {task}, done. Stealth rating acceptable. Recommended extraction: rest.
{task}: secured. Next objective, or a period of silence.
{task}: weeks-old file, now closed. Extraction complete. Rest is authorized.
Objective {task}: cleared. The shadows approve. Next mission, or stand down.
First objective of the day: {task}. Begin.
New operational day. One objective is sufficient.
Daily briefing. Primary objective: {task}. Secondary objective: none.
{task}: complete. Consecutive operational days: a few. Pattern noted.
Several consecutive days of cleared objectives. The laundry is concerned.
Ten days and more of cleared objectives. File reclassified: exemplary.
Operative returned. Mission resumes with {task}.
Re-entry successful. Today's objective: {task}. Nothing else is on file.
Welcome back to the shadows. Fresh file. One objective today.
Briefing over. Close the app. The mission is out there.
Screen time exceeds mission parameters. Close the app and move.
A ninja does not linger. Close the app. Rest, or proceed to the objective.
{task} is a large operation. Divided into three phases. Phase one only.
Objective {task}: too large for one approach. Three phases follow.
New mission file declassified. Review it later, after extraction.
Another chapter of the file is open. It is not urgent. Rest first.
